property_summary: For any uint value _val and caller, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract sets MinSum to that _val (so c.MinSum() == _val after the call); the mutant that unconditionally sets MinSum = 0 violates this when _val != 0.
change_summary: Set MinSum to zero unconditionally, so calling SetMinSum does not set the intended value and observable MinSum differs.
